_about: ZONEHITCH v1 (laneZONEHITCH), read by Assets/Scripts/Zones/ZoneHitch.cs. Only runs when the zone span is bound (zones on). log = one-frame timing of every zone step + a FRAME line for any frame over frameMs (names the culprit in the player log and the zonexing json/csv). spread.rowsPerFrame = ring rows switched per frame (0 = whole ring at once, the v107 behaviour). warm = behind an opaque cover once the span is bound: load the creature prefabs, draw their materials, render each ring once with a small temporary camera, touch the skyline. Flags: -zonehitch:off (all off, paired proof baseline), -zonehitch:log (timing only). UNPROVEN IN UNITY.

log._about: stepMs: a step at or over this is logged and sent to the zonexing marker column as ms:<step>=<ms>. frameMs: a frame at or over this gets a FRAME line (zone-code ms vs outside zone code, z, GC, texture streaming, memory).

spread._about: A ring group (40-114 rows) is woken or retired 16 rows per frame instead of in one SetActive (v107: 93-361 ms frames at ring switches). 0 = off.

warm._about: Pays the first-use cost of the later zones before the player walks there. cover = opaque black IMGUI cover while it runs (player runs only). rt = the small render target of the temporary camera.
